verdict.rationale: Working Copy is an iOS Git client, not a terminal or SSH session client, so connecting to a saved host the way a terminal does is outside its product type. Its SSH key identities (docs-20, docs-36) and SSH-based hosting-provider setup (docs-56) are used for Git transport and for listing repositories. They are not interactive host connections.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can connect to a saved host with one tap without re-entering credentials
